about: One rule per riftgen Tale-lead mechanic, in riftgen.json’s order (genre by genre, then index), with each mechanic’s exact text. Eight ship in Phase 4; the seven bright and Backhalls ones are puzzles that never fight; the rest fight as the plain fallback until their phase. xInt is the first estimate of each mechanic’s effective-Integrity multiplier, replaced by the tuning sim’s measurement (COMBAT.md §8.3).

mechanics.text: throttles everyone’s speed until you reroute the power
mechanics.name: Throttles speed
mechanics.rule: The party is Slowed 1 until 3 junctions are rerouted, an Interact each; then the lead is Dazed 2. From the Twist, one Aside a round throttles a junction again.
mechanics.bow: All three rerouted in one phase.

mechanics.text: splits into copies you have to tell apart
mechanics.name: Copies
mechanics.rule: At the Twist, two copies with 1 Integrity each; a hit or an Examine finds the real one.
mechanics.bow: The real one picked first time, every phase.

mechanics.text: hides behind a firewall that drops every third turn
mechanics.name: Firewall
mechanics.rule: Takes half damage except on rounds 3, 6, 9 and so on; a Spark hit brings the drop forward a round.
mechanics.bow: Its console switched off, with two Interacts.

mechanics.text: reboots at half strength, once
mechanics.name: Reboots once
mechanics.rule: Comes back at half Integrity unless its console is used that round.
mechanics.bow: The console used, then a Talk down.

mechanics.text: invites you to stay up; every ‘no’ weakens it
mechanics.name: Every no weakens it
mechanics.rule: One hero a round turns Beguiled on a Hit or better; “Say no” (1 action, by the Beguiled hero) takes 10%.

mechanics.text: turns off the streetlights one by one
mechanics.name: Streetlights out
mechanics.rule: A lamp goes dark at the start of each round, the first included; an Interact relights one. From the Twist, one Aside a round turns off another.
mechanics.bow: Every lamp lit in the Last page.

mechanics.text: makes the clock skip back an hour
mechanics.name: Clock skips back
mechanics.rule: Once a phase, it undoes last round’s damage to it, up to 15%.
mechanics.bow: The streetclock stopped, with two Interacts, or one from a hero with Might or Wit 3 or more.

mechanics.text: circles on a squeaky bicycle you have to cut across
mechanics.name: Squeaky bicycle
mechanics.rule: Rides a 12-tile loop, clipping anyone on it; a braced hero tumbles it.

mechanics.text: snuffs the candles; relight them to see
mechanics.name: Snuffs candles
mechanics.rule: Snuffs 2 candles at the start of each round, the first included; with 4 or more lit it loses its resistance. An Interact relights one; from the Twist, one Aside a round snuffs another.

mechanics.text: swaps places with a portrait
mechanics.name: Portrait swap
mechanics.rule: Swaps places among 3 to 5 portraits, 5 Integrity each.
mechanics.bow: Every portrait finished or forgiven with a Talk down each, not broken.

mechanics.text: reads your old letters aloud until you answer one
mechanics.name: Old letters
mechanics.rule: Spooked 1 on a hero each round on a Hit or better; “Answer” (2 actions at the lectern) takes a third.

mechanics.text: calls ravens that circle the room
mechanics.name: Ravens
mechanics.rule: It has +1 Guard while 2 ravens circle.
mechanics.bow: The ravens told the date, with a Talk down.

mechanics.text: adds a new assembly line every few turns; shut them down
mechanics.name: Assembly lines
mechanics.rule: Every 2 rounds, every round from the Twist, a running line makes a clerk, one standing per line, until clerks are talked down; a lever (2 actions) shuts the nearest line and takes 15%. Levers spring back each round.

mechanics.text: blows the shift whistle and everything speeds up
mechanics.name: Shift whistle
mechanics.rule: Everyone turns Brisk, then Winded, every third round.
mechanics.bow: The whistle pocketed, with an Interact from beside it while it’s Winded.

mechanics.text: stamps forms that block the doors
mechanics.name: Stamped forms
mechanics.rule: Paper walls (6 Integrity, weak to Light) block doors and sight.
mechanics.bow: Three forms filed at the desk, an Interact each.

mechanics.text: vents steam that hides the path
mechanics.name: Steam vents
mechanics.rule: Smog every round; Chill turns it into rain and puddles.

mechanics.text: is too big to see; name its first small step to shrink it
mechanics.name: Too big to see
mechanics.rule: Takes half damage; “Name a step” (2 actions, after an Examine, one a round) shrinks it to full damage until the phase ends, when it grows back.

mechanics.text: turns the room sideways
mechanics.name: Sideways
mechanics.rule: A telegraphed 3-tile slide; a Brace resists it.
mechanics.bow: The whole party braced through two slides.

mechanics.text: splits into many smaller things
mechanics.name: Splits
mechanics.rule: Four of the Too-Many a phase.
mechanics.bow: All of them settled, two phases running.

mechanics.text: hides in the parts of the map you haven’t looked at
mechanics.name: Hides unseen
mechanics.rule: Unseen wherever no hero sees it; light and a Bead pin it.
mechanics.bow: Pinned a whole round in the Last page.

mechanics.text: hides behind alibis; present evidence to break them
mechanics.name: Alibis
mechanics.rule: Takes half damage while every alibi stands; an Interact on a clue finds evidence, and one on an alibi with evidence breaks it. From the Twist, one Aside a round hides a found clue again while its evidence waits.

mechanics.text: turns off the lights and changes places
mechanics.name: Lights out
mechanics.rule: Once a phase, a blackout, then everyone swaps places.
mechanics.bow: Who’s where, named with a Seek after each swap.

mechanics.text: sends red herrings after you
mechanics.name: Sends red herrings
mechanics.rule: On a Hit or better, your next attack goes to a herring.
mechanics.bow: Three herrings shown up as false leads.

mechanics.text: speaks only in questions
mechanics.name: Questions
mechanics.rule: Answer as a reaction or turn Spooked 1; an Examine leaves it Dazed 1.
mechanics.bow: Every question answered for a phase.

mechanics.text: duels at noon: time your strike
mechanics.name: Noon duel
mechanics.rule: In the Last page, a duel with the hero highest on the ribbon at the end of each round’s first tick, in place of its Asides: whoever stands higher strikes first, at +1 edge.

mechanics.text: rides circles around you until you stand still
mechanics.name: Circles
mechanics.rule: Moves 10; +1 edge against anyone who strode this round, and −1 edge against it unless you stood still.
mechanics.bow: The whole party still for a round.

mechanics.text: calls a posse of meetings
mechanics.name: Posse
mechanics.rule: One walker a phase, at most 2 standing, and one more Aside while any stand.
mechanics.bow: The posse rescheduled, with a Talk down.

mechanics.text: accepts a fair parley (a real, honest reschedule)
mechanics.name: Fair parley
mechanics.rule: Only talking works: each phase settles after 2 plus its number in Talk downs (3, 4, then 5).

mechanics.text: grows every day it’s left alone; strike before landfall
mechanics.name: Grows daily
mechanics.rule: It has 10% more Integrity for each day its rift has been open, up to 30%, and never gains levels; each Colossus piece takes a day off. Wild ones close with the day, so they never grow.

mechanics.text: is beaten only by the assembled Crew Colossus
mechanics.name: Only the Colossus
mechanics.rule: Its last bar can’t empty until the Crew Colossus lands a blow; it fights as the plain fallback until Hana joins in Phase 8.

mechanics.text: stomps the shore; stand on the crew’s plan
mechanics.name: Stomps
mechanics.rule: A telegraphed stomp over about 60% of the room at the end of each round’s third tick meets body Resolve with its Strike; the crew’s plan tiles are safe. From the Twist, one Aside a round tramples one for the round.

mechanics.text: sets off every alarm; turn them off one by one
mechanics.name: Alarms
mechanics.rule: It’s Brisk while 2 of its 4 alarms ring; each one switched off takes 10%.

mechanics.text: no fight: plant three seeds and the rift blooms shut
mechanics.name: Plant three seeds
mechanics.rule: No fight: plant three seeds and the rift blooms shut.

mechanics.text: asks for a tour of your week’s good things
mechanics.name: A tour of good things
mechanics.rule: No fight: it asks for a tour of your week’s good things.

mechanics.text: no fight: a transformation sequence and a party
mechanics.name: A transformation
mechanics.rule: No fight: a transformation sequence and a party.

mechanics.text: asks you to name three small wins
mechanics.name: Three small wins
mechanics.rule: No fight: it asks you to name three small wins.

mechanics.text: no fight: sit still for one full focus session and break through
mechanics.name: One still session
mechanics.rule: No fight: sit still for one full focus session and break through.

mechanics.text: a trial of stillness: don’t click for a minute
mechanics.name: A trial of stillness
mechanics.rule: No fight: don’t click for a minute.

mechanics.text: no fight: find the one door that’s different
mechanics.name: The different door
mechanics.rule: No fight: find the one door that’s different.

fallback.rule: A plain Tale-lead: its bars, its phases and its quote, its Asides, and the last page at the end of round 8, off at Maud’s Table.
fallback.bow: It has no bow of its own; the last page ends it gently.
